description: Find customers by name, email, or phone (any combination is fine; all are optional). Returns matching customer records INCLUDING their numeric customer_id. Common usage: (a) call with NO arguments to browse recent customers when you don't yet know any names; (b) call FIRST with a name/email/phone whenever you have a person's identifier but need the customer_id required by list_orders / lookup_customer / list_transactions. Returns up to 25 customers, most-recently-created first.
